plan: Keep queueing jungle as primary — it is already Xeebs's usual queue AND best role at 53.1% over 332 games (overall is 50.4%).
Stop queueing carry: 42.9% over 198 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 6.0 more games per 100 on it.
Xeebs's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 39% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Drongo for ranked: 37% over 51. Keep them for normals.
The math: Xeebs is at 452 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: The tilt tax is real for Xeebs
insights.finding: Right after a loss Xeebs wins 47%; right after a win, 68%. One cooldown break after losses is free VP.
insights.receipt: 7/15 after losses vs 15/22 after wins, last 38 games

insights.title: Xeebs is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 71%. Past 32: 50%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 15 of 21 short games vs 5 of 10 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Vision is Xeebs's cheapest upgrade
insights.finding: 4.8 wards per game, 56% of the squad average. Wards cost nothing and they are being left in the shop.
insights.receipt: 4,514 placed + 282 cleared over 1008 games; squad average 8.5/game

insights.title: Khaimera is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 181 games and Xeebs genuinely out-pilots the field on Khaimera — about 6.0 more wins per 100 games than the average Khaimera player. The hours show.

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Xeebs's best
insights.finding: Xeebs's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 55% over 300 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.
